Title: Ireland – Cleaning and sanitation services in urban or rural areas, and related services – Dublin City Council Waste Management Services proposes to establish a Multi Party Framework for the Maintenance and Cleaning of Public Toilets
Procedure title: Dublin City Council Waste Management Services proposes to establish a Multi Party Framework for the Maintenance and Cleaning of Public Toilets
Description: This Multi Party Framework Agreement will be established for the provision of routine maintenance and cleaning of DCC Waste Management Services public toilets. For the purpose of this tender, daily cleaning intervals must be used, however, intervals may need to be amended from time to time based on need. Location and facilities covered by the initial contract Area City Centre Location St. Stephen’s Green Works Frequency Daily Duration 10am to 6pm Staff required 2 staff members No. of toilets 7 toilets and 2 urinals There is an initial contract for a duration of 1 year, with option to extend for a further 1 year. Successful tenderers must set out their labour costs per hour for the services and must include in the labour cost all cleaning products and equipment. These costs are the maximum cost of labour that will apply. This Multi Party Framework Agreement is assessed under the Open Procedure. Tenderers will initially be assessed under financial and economic and technical criteria as set out in the Suitability Assessment Criteria. Successful tenderers who pass all categories will be assessed under the outlined Award Criteria. The successful tenderer must hold regular meetings with DCC to formally review the contract. Unless otherwise stated in the contract document and these meetings must be bi-monthly for the first six months. Then six months later and thereafter unless DCC decides another frequency is required. Please note that this project is subject to funding. For further information please refer to documentation available to download from www.etenders.gov.ie Resource ID 9229493.
